text:
Liam: ok this is peak chaos: Noodle the corn snake modeled his new sweater in the ficus. pic: https://img.internal/noodle-sweater.jpg :snake: :sweater: 
Zoë: I cant believe that exists. who makes snake sweaters? do they come in saurus sizes? :joy: 
Hannah: tiny sweater heckin adorable. note: sweater has tiny armholes for... well, nothing, but vibes. 
Marta: also love the runway stance. Hes giving "slinky sophistication". 
Liam: seller is a tiny Etsy shop called "WarmBellyWears"  they list sizes as XS/S/M but recommend measuring chill factor. 
Zoë: poll: is this a fashion crime or a fashion statement? 
Hannah: fashion statement. mandatory runway next all-hands. 
Marta: fashion statement. also request: a sweater with an embroidered potato. Noodle loves tubers. 
ops-bot: Reminder: please avoid open plants in common spaces with pets. Plants can be sensitive to nibbling. :leafy_green: 
Liam: noted  the ficus escaped a little photo-bump, all good. 
Zoë: GIF: https://img.internal/noodle-slinky.gif  that slow slither moment is so cinematic. 
Hannah: also someone make a pun sticker: "Noodle-thread". I will not rest until it exists. 
Marta: vote: bring Noodle (and sweater) to next virtual show-and-tell? Options: Yes / No / Virtual only. 
Zoë: voted Virtual only (I will cry if I see this in person) 
Hannah: voted Yes. 
Liam: voted Yes. 
ops-bot: Poll created: "Snake in a sweater: show-and-tell?" 
Marta: final note: he sneezed once mid-photo and the sweater fluffed; 10/10, would clothe again.
